name: UWF Ultimate Championship
epitaph: First won by Archangel at the promotion's own inaugural pay-per-view, "Championship Mania," and held by "Big D" Devestation by the promotion's own 18 November 1999 broadcast.

name: UWF Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Held by Hoodlam, of the stable Dungeon of Devestation, through the middle of 1999.

name: UWF Intercontinental Championship
epitaph: Changed hands three times across 1999, from Rockin' Rebel to a two-time former champion, Deathstalker, and on to Mike "Showtime" Bradshaw, who denied Deathstalker a third reign.

name: UWF European Championship
epitaph: Held by Chaple through at least the middle of 1999, then by Shogun Assassin by the promotion's own 18 November 1999 broadcast.

name: UWF Light Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Recorded vacant in the promotion's own 21 July 1999 report.
